_doc: Worked examples the book uses to ground abstract claims. Each case study illustrates one or more Mechanisms or Concepts and appears in specific Chapters.

caseStudies.label: The telephone game
caseStudies.summary: Ten kids pass a sentence around a circle; the output barely resembles the input. The canonical pure-transport intuition — but note that the game forces every player to pass, removing the selection step that real social networks have.

caseStudies.label: Hammer of the Witches vs. Copernicus
caseStudies.summary: Same press technology, two generations apart (1486 and 1543). The Hammer ran through edition after edition; De revolutionibus was famously slow to sell (Koestler called it 'the book that nobody read'; Gingerich later showed specialists read it closely, which sharpens rather than weakens the contrast in reach). Pure-transport reads it as compressed-vs-complex. Selection reads it as identical transport cost with massively different fitness against contemporary criteria — fear, urgency, action affordance.

caseStudies.label: matplotlib vs. seaborn
caseStudies.summary: matplotlib: general, powerful, hard to use. seaborn: opinionated abstraction, lower ceiling, broader access. The 'software stratification' pattern — same trade-off shows up in religions, political platforms, scientific popularization.

caseStudies.label: Astrology
caseStudies.summary: Astronomical positions are real measurements; the interpretive framework is invented. Never survived consensus (never went through it), injected directly at curation and meme stages. Canonical example of manufactured content propagating through the same channels as measured content.

caseStudies.label: 'Scientists say X' headline
caseStudies.summary: A 20-year paper compresses to a meme within a week. Pure-transport says lossy hops; selection says the headline writer chose the highest-fitness finding, not the most load-bearing one. Both pipelines are operating.

caseStudies.label: Bitcoin: 'internet money' vs. full technical description
caseStudies.summary: 'Bitcoin is internet money' requires almost no preconditions. The full settlement-layer description requires five or six. Same object, two forms — only the compressed form has a chance of reaching unprepared receivers.

caseStudies.label: Power posing — the meme that survived its own corrective
caseStudies.summary: Carney/Cuddy/Yap 2010 reported that 'high-power' poses raised testosterone, lowered cortisol, and improved risk-task performance. Published in Psychological Science, popularized via Cuddy's 70M-view TED talk and the book Presence. Ranehill et al. 2015 failed to replicate; Carney publicly disavowed the work in 2016. Within the field the original is treated as a canonical replication-crisis case; in popular culture the meme keeps spreading, because the corrective signal has worse curation fitness than the original. Made-to-meme + meme-survived-the-correction is the chapter's prototype case.

caseStudies.label: Arsenic-life (Wolfe-Simon et al. 2010) — died at consensus
caseStudies.summary: December 2010 Science paper claiming GFAJ-1 bacteria could substitute arsenic for phosphorus in DNA. NASA press conference; initial curation began. Within hours independent biochemists pointed out methodological problems; within 18 months Science published technical comments and refutation showing the original measurement had been contaminated. Scientific consensus rejected the claim. The meme never propagated past the initial press cycle because the consensus gate caught the variant before curation could compound it. The book's worked example of the consensus stage working as designed.

caseStudies.label: Stanford Prison Experiment correctives — died at curation
caseStudies.summary: Zimbardo's 1971 SPE ran the pipeline cleanly to meme — textbooks, films, public-intellectual platform. 2018 Ben Blum reporting and Le Texier's 2018/2019 archival work showed Zimbardo coached guards and the famous prisoner breakdown was performed; consensus within social psychology accepted the methodological critique. The corrective passed measurement, analysis, and consensus — and died at curation. Textbooks still teach SPE; pop psychology still cites it; films are not being re-cut. The book's worked example of corrective signal failing at curation even when consensus has ratified it.

caseStudies.label: Latin Mass vs. vernacular liturgy
caseStudies.summary: Pre-Vatican-II Catholicism: the Latin Mass is high optionality, low access — ritual carries enormous doctrinal precision encoded across centuries; full participation requires a trained reader of the apparatus. The vernacular reform shifted to high access, lower precision — local-language liturgy that the broader laity can participate in, with many of the Latin form's specific theological commitments either flattened or absent. Optionality-vs-access trade-off in religion; canonical example of religions scaling past their original community by institutionalizing the split between a preservation-side (specialist apparatus) and an access-side (lay participation form).

caseStudies.label: A Brief History of Time
caseStudies.summary: Hawking's 1988 popularization of general relativity, quantum mechanics, and cosmology — written for readers with no physics background. By acknowledged design every equation past E=mc² was removed; technical apparatus was substituted with analogies; qualifications were compressed into single sentences. Sold over 25 million copies. The original papers Hawking popularized have probably been read in full by under ten thousand people. Optionality-vs-access trade in scientific popularization, with the same shape as software stratification: the popular form gains reach by trading the precision the technical form preserves.

caseStudies.label: Statutes vs. plain-language legal summaries
caseStudies.summary: A statute drafted by professional legislative counsel encodes precision through scope-defined clauses, defined-term interactions, and 'shall/may/subject to' constructions whose load-bearing work is invisible to non-lawyers. A plain-language summary of the same statute is accessible but wrong about the edge cases the original carefully handled. The legal apparatus is structurally committed to both ends of the curve simultaneously — the statute is preservation, the summary is access — with a professional class (lawyers) doing the per-case translation between them. The cleanest institutional bridge in the book's optionality-vs-access examples, and the one whose access is most explicitly wealth-gated.

caseStudies.label: The Voyager Golden Record
caseStudies.summary: Hofstadter's canonical illustration of the three-layer message. A record launched into deep space with no shared context to assume: the recorded sounds and images are the inner message, the playback diagrams etched on the cover are the outer message, and the artifact's evident designed-ness is the frame message. The rare case where all three layers had to be shipped together.

caseStudies.label: COVID mask guidance — a reversal read as a lie
caseStudies.summary: In early 2020 the CDC and WHO advised the public not to wear masks, bundling a genuine wish to preserve scarce medical masks with an early droplet-over-aerosol read of the evidence; on April 3, 2020 the CDC reversed to recommend cloth coverings as aerosol transmission became clearer. That is a field updating on evidence. The bridge zone shipped it as two confident slogans, "masks don't work" then "masks work," with the decoding key (the supply motive, the provisional evidence) stripped, so the reversal read not as science working but as experts lying or flip-flopping. The inversion regime operating on institutional credibility itself, and the case that did the most public-trust damage.

caseStudies.label: Nutrition science — forty years of monocausal reversals
caseStudies.summary: Fat, then low-fat, then carbs, then sugar, then ultra-processed food: a forty-year sequence in which the field says "it's complicated and confounded" and the bridge zone ships a confident single-cause story on repeat. Each reversal is a real finding stripped of its hedges and conditions and sold as a clean actionable line, leaving the audience with a working model of nutrition worse than none. The specialist consensus was itself more contested than a clean story admits (food-industry conflicts run through nutrition epidemiology), but the whiplash the public experienced is a bridge-zone artifact, not a property of the science.

caseStudies.label: Monetary policy in the financial press
caseStudies.summary: Financial-press coverage of monetary policy collapses aggregates, velocity, and transmission mechanisms into "the Fed is printing money." This is where the political economy of attention bites hardest, because some outlets are owned by interests with positions on what policy should be, so the compression is not only lossy but directional. Monetary policy is genuinely full of paradigm wars, so the specialist consensus is contested too; the point is that the bridge-zone product is systematically wrong about the technical distinctions in a direction that serves its owners.

caseStudies.label: Common-law courts as a curation institution
caseStudies.summary: Common-law courts run on generationally trained judges (a multi-decade consumer-key substrate), precedent as preservation, transparent written provenance, and redundant independent jurisdictions, all publicly funded. Read through the book's design principles, they hold funding-decoupling and consumer-key defense the longest and do correspondingly well. Their redundancy only works while the jurisdictions stay genuinely independent, which political capture of appointments erodes: the failure mode the principles predict.

caseStudies.label: Stack Overflow — curation without funding decoupling
caseStudies.summary: Stack Overflow had strong reputation-weighted curation and auditable provenance but was never decoupled from the attention market (ad-supported and venture-backed from its 2008 launch). When LLMs began answering its questions directly, readers took the compressed model answer instead of the curated community one, traffic fell sharply after 2022, and with no funding reserve it had nothing to ride out the shock. The case that shows curation and provenance are not enough without the funding principle, and Chapter 11's worst case landing on a real curation layer.
